text: The two-column news overview: Updates (left, with the Marketplace posts) and Announcements (right), the newest post of each as a big card. Put {{NewsFeed}} on the page News. Optional: limit= = how many small cards per column (default 11).
html: The two-column news overview: Updates (left, with the Marketplace posts) and Announcements (right), the newest post of each as a big card. Put {{NewsFeed}} on the page News. Optional: limit= = how many small cards per column (default 11).
wikitext:
Updates
{{#cargo_query:tables=News|fields=_pageName=Page,Title,Date,Category,Image,Summary|where=Category IN ('Update','Marketplace')|order by=Date DESC|limit=1|format=template|template=NewsFeatured|named args=yes|default=''No updates yet.''}}
{{#cargo_query:tables=News|fields=_pageName=Page,Title,Date,Category,Image,Summary|where=Category IN ('Update','Marketplace')|order by=Date DESC|limit={{{limit|11}}}|offset=1|format=template|template=NewsCard|named args=yes|default=}}
Announcements
{{#cargo_query:tables=News|fields=_pageName=Page,Title,Date,Category,Image,Summary|where=Category='Announcement'|order by=Date DESC|limit=1|format=template|template=NewsFeatured|named args=yes|default=''No announcements yet.''}}
{{#cargo_query:tables=News|fields=_pageName=Page,Title,Date,Category,Image,Summary|where=Category='Announcement'|order by=Date DESC|limit={{{limit|11}}}|offset=1|format=template|template=NewsCard|named args=yes|default=}}
[[News/Archive|All older news →]]
The two-column news overview: Updates (left, with the Marketplace posts) and Announcements (right), the newest post of each as a big card. Put {{NewsFeed}} on the page [[News]]. Optional: limit= = how many small cards per column (default 11).
